concerns.text: FR-001 requires generation of short‑range structural descriptors for **≥ 500** valid compositions. The task list only creates a pilot set of 24 compositions (T001‑T016) and never includes any later task to scale up to 500. This is a direct weakening of the functional requirement without a formal amendment to the spec.

SC-002 mandates ROC‑AUC > 0.7 for the crystallization classifier. T019’s verification only checks that the metric is recorded; it does not enforce the > 0.7 threshold nor fail the pipeline if the criterion is not met, leaving the success criterion unverified.

SC-003 requires measuring the stability of the top‑3 descriptors across families via SHAP importance **confidence intervals**. Tasks T022‑T023 compute SHAP values and summary plots but never generate confidence intervals or a statistical test, making the criterion untestable.
